responsibility: Implements the core C/C++ side of the Visium GCC backend. This file owns the target hooks and helper logic behind calling conventions, return values, varargs handling, frame layout and prologue/epilogue expansion, register classes and secondary reload decisions, condition-code mode selection, branch and compare lowering, block move/set expansion, trampoline and libfunc setup, target attributes such as interrupt handlers, assembly output helpers, and the custom visium reorg pass, providing the executable semantics that the RTL patterns in visium.md rely on.
same_name_distinction: The executable backend implementation file for the Visium port: unlike visium.h it provides code rather than target macros, unlike visium.md it supplies the C++ hook bodies and helper routines that the machine description calls (such as prologue/epilogue, block move/set, cstore and attribute handling), and unlike visium.opt it consumes target option state instead of declaring the options.
